results.name: Activity 9: Header initially displays zero and receives only the derived numeric count
Original billboard: eight movies, 24 showtimes, header, banner and footer
Reusable Button: primary banner link, secondary favorite buttons and preserved navigation
Favorites: add two movies through onClick, visual variants and no duplicated IDs
Favorites: remove and re-add without changing other movies or reloading
localStorage: favorites and selected buttons survive an actual page reload
Controlled search inside banner: onChange updates input immediately, not the list
400 ms debounce: intermediate timers canceled, one console message and delayed result
MovieList: partial title, case-insensitive matching, surrounding spaces and favorite state
Empty state: unmatched title displays zero results and an accessible status message
Clearing search restores all original data, schedules and favorites
Removing all favorites persists an empty array after reload
Saved IDs are validated: duplicates and IDs outside the original billboard are discarded
Desktop and mobile layouts preserve the billboard without horizontal overflow
Browser console and local image requests have no errors
Favorite notification: adding shows one accessible message and preserves the existing counts
Favorite notification: removal replaces the existing message without duplicates
Favorite notification: rapid toggles stay deduplicated and do not block searching
Favorite notification: mobile layout, automatic dismissal and persistence after reload
useWindowSize layout: 1440px shows 4 columns without overflow
useWindowSize layout: 1200px shows 4 columns without overflow
useWindowSize layout: 1199px shows 3 columns without overflow
useWindowSize layout: 900px shows 3 columns without overflow
useWindowSize layout: 899px shows 2 columns without overflow
useWindowSize layout: 600px shows 2 columns without overflow
useWindowSize layout: 599px shows 1 columns without overflow
useWindowSize layout: 390px shows 1 columns without overflow
useWindowSize layout: 320px shows 1 columns without overflow
useWindowSize layout: search, notifications and persistent favorites survive resizing
Activity 8 app: initial Skeleton transitions to four premieres after the real request delay
Activity 8 carousel: desktop buttons, Tab and Enter navigate accessibly
Activity 8 carousel: mobile buttons, Home, End and native scrolling remain contained
Activity 8 app: premieres remain independent of search, favorites, notifications and persistence
Activity 9: multiple cards update the sibling Header without duplicated favorite IDs
Activity 9: removing a favorite decrements the count and keeps the other cards selected
Activity 9: a real reload restores both Header count and favorite card states
Activity 9: removing every favorite persists a zero count after reload
Activity 10: keyboard clearing synchronizes banner input and list immediately without reloading
Activity 10: clearing an unmatched search removes the empty state and restores all results
Activity 10: a pending search is canceled before 400 ms and cannot restore stale results
Activity 10: typing immediately after clear never reveals the previously confirmed search
Activities 9 and 10: mobile count, keyboard clearing, navigation and carousel remain accessible
useDebounce: initial and unchanged values do not schedule unnecessary updates
useDebounce: default delay is exactly 400 ms and identical rerenders do not restart it
useDebounce: rapid values cancel previous timers and publish only the final value
useDebounce: configurable delays, changed delays and zero delay are respected
useDebounce: returning to the published value cancels a pending change
useDebounce: non-string values retain their original identity
useDebounce: unmount clears pending timers under StrictMode
useWindowSize: initial dimensions and one active listener under StrictMode
useWindowSize: resize updates both width and height without adding listeners
useWindowSize: unchanged dimensions preserve state identity and avoid commits
useWindowSize: unmount removes the listener and stops subsequent updates
useWindowSize: repeated StrictMode mounts do not accumulate listeners
usePremieres: initial loading lasts 800 ms with one pending StrictMode request
usePremieres: success returns four adapted local movies and completes only once
usePremieres: controlled failure provides an understandable error and no data
usePremieres: stable retry transitions error to loading to success
usePremieres: equivalent options and rerenders do not restart or duplicate requests
usePremieres: unmount cancels timers and ignores even forced late callbacks
usePremieres: changed options cancel stale attempts and retry recovers deterministically
Activity 8 section: accessible Skeleton has poster, title and metadata placeholders at every width
Activity 8 Skeleton: reduced-motion preference disables its subtle animation
Activity 8 section: Skeleton remains at 799 ms and disappears for the four movies at 800 ms
Activity 8 section: controlled error exposes a clear alert and an accessible retry button
Activity 8 section: keyboard retry invokes the hook and recovers through loading to success
Activity 8 carousel: movies are reusable props without another request or artificial records
